answers.text: "Swing-high clear on day_vol 1.18, under 1.40; late buy." A 1.40 volume floor is not my test; day_vol is only a proxy for fill difficulty, which I cannot see (R5). C5/C16 buy the new high: W HH/HL, D HH/HL with dist_to_20bar_high 1.4%, so price is at its high, not chasing far above it. H1 below EMA9 at 49% of range is a pause, not a danger signal. Not conceded.

"BOS on day_vol 0.85; weekly swing LH/LL, extended leg." Volume floor is not my test (R5). The weekly label LH/LL is about past pivots: close 370.45 is above both the last weekly swing high 335.8 and the prior one 358.0, so the weekly pivotal point is cleared (C17/C19). D HH/HL, 2.9% under 20-day high. H1 LH/LL below EMA9 is noted; I still buy only the fresh high. Not conceded.

"15.7% past the D swing high on day_vol 0.81." A fast move after a cleared pivot is C17's expected follow-through, not a reject; volume is not my test (R5). W 5.5% above the last weekly swing high, D dist_to_20bar_high 2.0%: a leader at its high. Extension raises the odds of a danger-signal day, which I hold as my exit (C7), not as a reason against. Not conceded.

"Trend Template FAIL: ma50 under ma100, rs_rank_pct 68.65." Moving-average stacks and rs_rank_pct are not on my menu; I cannot rule by them. My test: D dist_to_20bar_high 0.3%, H1 91% of the day's range, W 0.8% above the last weekly swing high. The W 20-bar high 58.7 is still 1.4% overhead, so the weekly pivot is the next proof, not a reason to stand aside. Not conceded.

"H1 closed at 14% of range; Recovering is not leading." This I accept. C12 wants leaders in leading groups, and the confirming high is not printed: W 6.8% under the 20-wk high, D 3.8% under the 20-day high, H1 below EMA9 at 14% of range. That is a stock still inside its reaction, and C5 forbids buying the pullback. I move to ABSTAIN until a fresh high prints.

"Inverted stack ma50 < ma100 < ma200; group cannot repair it." The averages are not my fields, but they point at what my grid shows: W swing LH/LL, 4.6% under the 20-wk high, the W prior swing high 118.32 not retaken. No established weekly Upward Trend, so C5 has nothing to buy into yet; the daily HH is a rally in a downward column (C18). I move to ABSTAIN.

"Break printed on day_vol 1.01, under 1.40." Volume floor is not my test (R5). W close is 5.9% above the last weekly swing high 90.36 and above the prior one 92.49, 1.8% under the 20-wk high; D HH/HL 0.3% through the swing high. An established trend at its pivot. I buy the fresh high, adding only higher (C5/C6). Not conceded.
